info.title: Wherezy API
info.description: LAN-only Wherezy Household Inventory API v2 with Profiles, Activity, Tags, Reminders, Audits, Inbox, and Moving

get.description:
Combined system liveness check and Data Health summary counts.
Returns only liveness fields when unauthenticated or using a display profile.
Retrieve detailed items for a specific health check.

schema.title: Response Get Health Items Api Health  Check Name  Get

get.description: List profiles for the 'Who's using?' picker or admin settings.

schema.title: Response List Profiles Api Profiles Get

post.description: Admin or Co-Admin creates a new household profile.

get.description: Returns the currently active profile or 401.

post.description: Select profile with optional PIN; sets session cookie.

put.description: Update current user's display preferences (accent, language, text scale, contrast, theme).
Admin or Co-Admin updates another profile's preferences.
Admin or Co-Admin updates profile details or password.

delete.description: Deactivate profile (profiles with history are never deleted to preserve actor names).

schema.title: Response Get Item Activity Api Items  Item Id  Activity Get
Response Get Location Activity Api Locations  Location Id  Activity Get

get.description: List all tags with active items count.

schema.title: Response List Tags Api Tags Get

post.description: Execute bulk operations on items (move, tags, taken-out, expiry, retire, box, delete).
Dry-run preview of bulk operations before confirmation.
Replay inverse operations to undo a batch.

get.description: List computed reminders (overdue, due_soon, snoozed, dismissed) for current user.

schema.title: Response Get Reminders Api Reminders Get

post.description: Snooze a reminder for current profile.
Dismiss a reminder for current profile.
Test the configured LAN webhook URL.

schema.title: Response Get Location Audits Api Locations  Location Id  Audits Get

get.description: List deleted items, locations, and categories.

schema.title: Response List Trash Api Trash Get

get.description: List items currently sitting in inbox.

schema.title: Response List Inbox Items Api Inbox Get

post.description: Sort an inbox item into active inventory.

schema.title: Response List Contacts Api Contacts Get
Response List Moves Api Moves Get
Response List Boxes Api Moves  Move Id  Boxes Get
Response List Label Templates Api Label Templates Get

get.description:
Generate and stream complete multi-sheet Inventory Book Excel workbook.
Formula leading chars escaped.
Provides structured JSON data for printable /book client rendering.

Read-only kitchen tablet wall display data.
Strictly NO phone numbers, active items only.
Accessible by display profiles (is_display = 1).

schema.title: Response List Second Copy Files Api Admin Second Copy Files Get

get.description:
Complete active read-only snapshot for client IndexedDB storage.
Viewers NEVER receive contact phone numbers.
Incremental sync: changed rows + tombstones for deleted/retired/inbox items.

schema.title: Response List Categories Api Categories Get
Response List Fields Api Categories  Category Id  Fields Get
